_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Structure profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDataStructure/schema.yaml (refined: each concrete DataStructure variant restricts the allowed component subtypes; ForeignKey.isComposedOf points at InstanceVariable; ForeignKey.references points at PrimaryKey; the previous ForeignKeyComponent / PrimaryKeyComponent classes are gone). No abstract supertypes for DataStructure or DataStructureComponent: an abstract layer would hide the per-subtype component restrictions (Dimensional uses Identifier/Measure/Attribute/Dimension; Long uses Identifier/VariableDescriptor/VariableValue/Attribute; Wide uses Identifier/Measure/Attribute; general DataStructure accepts any). Each concrete DataStructure variant has explicit edges to the specific component subtypes it allows.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Structure Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Structure Profile
targetModel.subTitle: DataStructure variants (general / Dimensional / Long / Wide), component subtypes, keys, foreign keys, dimension groups
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Structure profile module. Adds cdi:isStructuredBy on a DataDownload, pointing at one of four DataStructure variants - DataStructure (general; any component subtype), DimensionalDataStructure (Identifier/Measure/Attribute/Dimension components), LongDataStructure (Identifier/VariableDescriptor/VariableValue/Attribute components), WideDataStructure (Identifier/Measure/Attribute components). Each structure may also carry a PrimaryKey and ForeignKeys. The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data structure description extension classes added by this profile.

package.name: Structures
package.definition: The four concrete DataStructure variants (DataStructure / Dimensional / Long / Wide) plus DimensionGroup. cdi:isStructuredBy on a DataDownload accepts any of the four.

package.name: Components
package.definition: The six concrete cdifDataStructureComponent subtypes used by the DataStructure variants. Full attribute structure for each subtype lives in cdifDataType/cdifDataStructureComponent.

package.name: Keys
package.definition: PrimaryKey + ForeignKey. Both are composed of cdi:InstanceVariables (cdif:isComposedOf); ForeignKey additionally references a PrimaryKey on another structure.

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of classes from cdifCore / cdifDataDescription this profile attaches to or references.

class._comment: DataDownload stub - the host for cdi:isStructuredBy. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. The data-structure profile adds the cdi:isStructuredBy property on each schema:distribution DataDownload item, pointing at one of the four DataStructure variants.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - carries the required https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0 conformance declaration.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the data-structure profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0 for the data-structure profile.

class._comment: RepresentedVariable stub - referenced by PrimaryKey.isComposedOf and ForeignKey.isComposedOf. Full definition in cdifDataType/cdifRepresentedVariable.
class.definition: Stub of cdifDataType::cdifRepresentedVariable. Referenced by both PrimaryKey.isComposedOf and ForeignKey.isComposedOf - each membership in a key carries a cdif:position integer alongside the variable reference.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the represented variable.

class._comment: DataStructure - the general variant. Accepts ANY component subtype (the JSON schema uses a generic cdifDataStructureComponent ref). Optional PrimaryKey + ForeignKey.
class.definition: Generic data organization. Carries at least one cdi:has_DataStructureComponent (any of the six concrete component subtypes), plus optional cdi:has_PrimaryKey and cdi:has_ForeignKey[].

class._comment: DimensionalDataStructure - cube-shaped. Components restricted to IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent / DimensionComponent. Optional PrimaryKey + ForeignKey.
class.definition: Dimensional data set (multidimensional cube). Components are restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension. Optional PrimaryKey and ForeignKey.

class._comment: LongDataStructure - narrow / variable-value-pair row layout. Required: exactly one Identifier + one VariableDescriptor + one VariableValue. Optional Attribute. Optional PrimaryKey.
class.definition: Long (narrow) dataset row layout. Required: exactly one IdentifierComponent, one VariableDescriptorComponent, one VariableValueComponent. Optional AttributeComponents. Optional PrimaryKey.

class._comment: WideDataStructure - wide-format tabular layout. Components restricted to IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent. Optional PrimaryKey + ForeignKey.
class.definition: Wide (tabular) dataset layout. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute. Optional PrimaryKey and ForeignKey.

class._comment: DimensionGroup - reusable collection of dimensions referenced across multiple dimensional structures.
class.definition: Reusable collection of dimensions that can be shared across multiple dimensional structures. Carries cdi:identifier, cdif:name, cdif:has_DataStructureComponent (any subtype).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the dimension group.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: cdif:name - human-readable name for the dimension group (ISO/IEC 11179-5).

class._comment: IdentifierComponent - role of a data structure component for content identification. Used by DataStructure, Dimensional, Long, Wide.
class.definition: Data-structure component for content identification. Used by all four DataStructure variants. Full attributes (cdif:isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable, ...) in cdifDataType/cdifDataStructureComponent.

class._comment: MeasureComponent - data structure component representing measure values. Used by DataStructure, Dimensional, Wide.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing a measure (the values being recorded). Used by general DataStructure, Dimensional, and Wide structures.

class._comment: AttributeComponent - data structure component for qualifying / contextual attribute values. Used by all four DataStructure variants.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing an attribute (qualifying or contextual value alongside the primary measures). Used by all four DataStructure variants.

class._comment: DimensionComponent - data structure component for a dimension along which measures vary. Specific to DataStructure (general) and DimensionalDataStructure.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing a dimension along which measures vary. Specific to dimensional / cube structures (and accepted by the general DataStructure).

class._comment: VariableDescriptorComponent - identifies which InstanceVariable a long-format row represents. Specific to DataStructure (general) and LongDataStructure (exactly one required).
class.definition: Data-structure component naming which InstanceVariable a long-format row represents (the descriptor column). Specific to LongDataStructure (exactly one required) and the general DataStructure.

class._comment: VariableValueComponent - carries the actual value for the variable identified by a VariableDescriptorComponent. Specific to DataStructure (general) and LongDataStructure (exactly one required).
class.definition: Data-structure component carrying the value for the variable named by a VariableDescriptorComponent in a long-format row. Specific to LongDataStructure (exactly one required) and the general DataStructure.

class._comment: PrimaryKey - role of an ordered set of InstanceVariables uniquely identifying a data instance. Array order of cdif:isComposedOf gives the position.
class.definition: Role of an ordered set of cdi:InstanceVariables that uniquely identify each data instance. Position is implicit in cdif:isComposedOf array order.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this primary key.

class._comment: ForeignKey - role of a set of cdi:InstanceVariables for content referencing. Composed of InstanceVariables (cdi:isComposedOf) and references a PrimaryKey on another structure (cdi:references).
class.definition: Role of a set of cdi:InstanceVariables for content referencing. cdi:isComposedOf is a list of InstanceVariables in this structure; cdi:references is the PrimaryKey in another structure that this foreign key references.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this foreign key.

association._comment: DataDownload -> CatalogRecord (via the dataset's schema:subjectOf back-ref).
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.0.

association._comment: cdi:isStructuredBy: one edge per allowed structure variant (the schema's anyOf at distribution items.cdi:isStructuredBy).
association.definition: cdi:isStructuredBy - general DataStructure variant. Accepts any component subtype.
cdi:isStructuredBy - dimensional (cube) variant. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension.
cdi:isStructuredBy - long (narrow) variant. Required: exactly one Identifier + VariableDescriptor + VariableValue; optional Attribute.
cdi:isStructuredBy - wide (tabular) variant. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute.

association._comment: DataStructure (general) -> any of the 6 component subtypes via cdi:has_DataStructureComponent. One edge per allowed subtype (schema uses generic ref so all are allowed).
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - IdentifierComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - MeasureComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - AttributeComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - DimensionComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - VariableDescriptorComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - VariableValueComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).

association._comment: DimensionalDataStructure -> Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension components only.
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Identifier components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Measure components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Attribute components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Dimension components on a dimensional structure.

association._comment: LongDataStructure -> exactly one Identifier + VariableDescriptor + VariableValue, plus optional Attribute. Multiplicity reflects the schema's contains constraints (exactly one of three required types).
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one IdentifierComponent (long-format identifier column).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one VariableDescriptorComponent (names which InstanceVariable the row represents).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one VariableValueComponent (carries the value).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - optional Attribute components.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Identifier components on a wide structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Measure components on a wide structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Attribute components on a wide structure.

association._comment: All DataStructure variants -> PrimaryKey via cdi:has_PrimaryKey (optional on all four).
association.definition: cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on the general DataStructure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a long structure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a wide structure.

association._comment: DataStructure / DimensionalDataStructure / WideDataStructure -> ForeignKey via cdi:has_ForeignKey (LongDataStructure does NOT have foreign keys in the refined schema).
association.definition: cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on the general DataStructure variant.
cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on a wide structure.

association._comment: DimensionGroup -> the 6 component subtypes via cdif:has_DataStructureComponent (schema uses generic ref).
association.definition: cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - IdentifierComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - MeasureComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - AttributeComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - DimensionComponent (any subtype permitted).

association._comment: PrimaryKey -> RepresentedVariable via cdif:isComposedOf. Each item is a RepresentedVariable (or @id-reference) plus a required cdif:position integer (1-based position in the key).
association.definition: cdif:isComposedOf - the RepresentedVariables that make up the key. Each item is a {RepresentedVariable (inline or @id-reference), cdif:position (positive integer)} pair; the position is the 1-based position of the component in the key.

association._comment: ForeignKey -> RepresentedVariable via cdi:isComposedOf. Same shape as PrimaryKey.isComposedOf: each membership carries a cdif:position integer.
association.definition: cdi:isComposedOf - the RepresentedVariables in this structure that make up the foreign key. Each item is a {RepresentedVariable (inline or @id-reference), cdif:position (positive integer)} pair.

association._comment: ForeignKey -> PrimaryKey via cdi:references. The foreign key points at the PrimaryKey of another structure.
association.definition: cdi:references - the PrimaryKey on another DataStructure that this foreign key references.
